title: Digital receivable processed successfully
description: Emitted as the digital_receivable_processed_success event type (schema version 1) when an asynchronous contract or negotiable instrument act operation is applied to a digital receivable: contract creation applied to existing or newly created receivables, contract updates (payment changes, exclusions and renegotiation), contract terminations, and creation, update or termination of negotiable instrument acts. One event is emitted per affected digital receivable, carrying its state after the operation. Consumers can use feature_type and operation_type to tell which operation changed the receivable.

digital_receivable_id.title: Digital receivable ID
digital_receivable_id.description: Client-provided identifier of the digital receivable, up to 20 characters, unique per organization.

contract_id.title: Contract ID
contract_id.description: UUID generated by Pismo for the contract linked to the digital receivable, or for the contract being unlinked on contract exclusions and terminations. Absent when the receivable has no linked contract.

contract_operation_id.title: Contract operation ID
contract_operation_id.description: Client-provided operation ID of the contract referenced by contract_id. Absent when contract_id is absent.

digital_receivable_unit_id.title: Digital receivable unit ID
digital_receivable_unit_id.description: UUID generated by Pismo for the digital receivable unit that groups the receivable. Absent when the receivable is not linked to a unit.

processed_instrument_act_id.title: Processed instrument act ID
processed_instrument_act_id.description: Client-provided ID of the negotiable instrument act added to or removed from the digital receivable, according to operation_type. Present only for negotiable instrument act operations.

instrument_act_ids.title: Instrument act IDs
instrument_act_ids.description: Client-provided IDs of all negotiable instrument acts currently linked to the digital receivable, ordered by creation time. Absent when no act is linked and on renegotiation events.

lender_document_number.title: Lender document number
lender_document_number.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the lender, client-provided on digital receivable creation and never changed afterwards.

debtor_document_number.title: Debtor document number
debtor_document_number.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the debtor, client-provided on digital receivable creation and never changed afterwards.

face_value.title: Face value
face_value.description: Current face value of the digital receivable in BRL with up to 5 decimal places, client-provided on creation and changed only by an explicit update.

maturity_date.title: Maturity date
maturity_date.description: Current maturity date of the digital receivable in yyyy-MM-dd format, client-provided on creation and changed only by an explicit update.

situation_type.title: Situation type
situation_type.description: Current situation of the digital receivable, from the DigitalReceivableSituationType enum. ACTIVE: the receivable is live and free to be negotiated. BLOCKED: the receivable is live but encumbered, for example by a guarantee contract or an endorsement pledge. COMPLETED: the receivable was fully settled and has no available balance. INACTIVE: the receivable was cancelled through a settlement of type CANCELLATION. Reflects the state after the operation was applied.

reason_type.title: Reason type
reason_type.description: Reason behind the current situation_type, from the ReasonType enum, either client-provided on creation or derived by Pismo from contracts, instrument acts and settlements. LIVR: Livre, free of restrictions and available for negotiation. BLOQ: Comprometida, committed to a contract or negotiable instrument act. BQSD: Bloqueada pelo sacador, blocked by the drawer (lender). BQCJ: Bloqueada por constrição judicial, blocked by a court order. COMT: Completada, the receivable is settled. Absent when no reason type is set.

owner_type.title: Owner type
owner_type.description: How the current owner obtained the digital receivable: OWNR when the original lender still owns it, CESS after an assignment by contract and ENDS after an endorsement by negotiable instrument act.

owner_document_number.title: Owner document number
owner_document_number.description: CPF or CNPJ of the current owner of the digital receivable, updated by Pismo when a contract assigns the receivable or an endorsement act is applied.

owner_name.title: Owner name
owner_name.description: Name of the current owner of the digital receivable, updated together with owner_document_number.

beneficiary_document_number.title: Beneficiary document number
beneficiary_document_number.description: CPF or CNPJ of the current beneficiary of the digital receivable payments, updated by Pismo when a contract or negotiable instrument act changes the beneficiary.

beneficiary_name.title: Beneficiary name
beneficiary_name.description: Name of the current beneficiary of the digital receivable payments, updated together with beneficiary_document_number.

beneficiary_type.title: Beneficiary type
beneficiary_type.description: Effect under which the beneficiary receives the payments: OWNR for the original lender, CEFD for a fiduciary assignment, EDPN for an endorsement pledge and PENR for a pledge. Absent when the linked contract type does not define a beneficiary effect.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Payment instructions currently registered for the digital receivable, grouped by payment method. Absent when no payment details are registered; each list is absent when it has no items.

bank_slips.title: Bank slips
bank_slips.description: Bank slips registered for the digital receivable.

pix.title: PIX keys
pix.description: PIX keys registered to receive the digital receivable payments.

ted.title: TED accounts
ted.description: Bank accounts registered to receive the digital receivable payments by TED.

feature_type.title: Feature type
feature_type.description: Functionality that triggered the event, serialized from the FeatureType enum. CREATE_CONTRACT: a contract was created and applied. UPDATE_CONTRACT: a contract was updated, including payment updates, exclusions and renegotiations. DELETE_CONTRACT: a contract was terminated and unlinked. CREATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: a negotiable instrument act was created and applied. UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: a negotiable instrument act was updated. DELETE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: a negotiable instrument act was terminated and unlinked.

operation_type.title: Operation type
operation_type.description: Specific operation within feature_type, serialized from the OperationType enum, for example CONTRACT_DIGITAL_RECEIVABLE_UNIT_CREATE or DIGITAL_RECEIVABLE_SUPPLEMENT_CREATE when a contract creates the receivable, UPDATE_CONTRACT_INCL, UPDATE_CONTRACT_ALTE or UPDATE_CONTRACT_EXCL for contract inclusions, changes and exclusions, CANCELLATION_ERROR, CLOSING, CLOSING_DJUD or CLOSING_RNGC for contract terminations, and CREATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT, UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT_ALTE, UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT_EXCL, CLOSING_ENEP, CLOSING_ENEM or CLOSING_ENES for negotiable instrument acts.

bank_slip.title: Bank slip
bank_slip.description: Bank slip (boleto) registered as a payment instruction for the digital receivable.

bar_code.title: Bar code
bar_code.description: Bar code line of the bank slip, client-provided.

pix.title: PIX key
pix.description: PIX key registered as a payment instruction for the digital receivable.

type.title: PIX key type
type.description: Numeric PIX key type mapped from the PixType enum. 1: CPF key. 2: CNPJ key. 3: phone number key. 4: email key. 5: random key. 6: copy and paste (QR code) key.

value.title: PIX key value
value.description: Value of the PIX key, client-provided and formatted according to type.

ted.title: TED account
ted.description: Bank account registered to receive the digital receivable payments by TED.

compe.title: COMPE code
compe.description: 3-digit COMPE code of the bank, client-provided.

ispb.title: ISPB code
ispb.description: 8-digit ISPB code identifying the bank in the Brazilian payment system, client-provided.

account_number.title: Account number
account_number.description: Bank account number without the check digit, client-provided.

account_digit.title: Account digit
account_digit.description: Check digit of the bank account, client-provided.

account_type.title: Account type
account_type.description: Type of the bank account, client-provided and validated against the AccountType values CC, CD, PG, PP, CCOR and CPAG.

owner_document_number.title: Owner document number
owner_document_number.description: CPF or CNPJ of the bank account holder, client-provided.
